Title: Setting Up a CI/CD Pipeline with GitHub Actions for Stream Analytics Jobs

Body.Content:
Are you using GitHub for managing your Stream Analytics project and looking to leverage GitHub's powerful CI/CD pipeline? Look no further! We have just released a comprehensive guide that walks you through the process of setting up of a CI/CD pipeline with GitHub Actions for your Stream Analytics jobs.

In the article, you will discover step-by-step instructions to build a CI/CD pipeline, including:

  • Exporting jobs to VSCode and publishing them to GitHub
  • Setting up repository secrets
  • Creating a workflow using GitHub Actions

By leveraging the automation capabilities of GitHub Actions, you can effortlessly speed up the entire build, test, and deployment process, saving valuable time and effort. Check out our detailed guide here: Set up a pipeline using GitHub Actions.
